# AbstractEntity

> The Entity app for AbstractFramework, published on npm as `@abstractframework/entity`: create entities (AI companions with a lasting memory that live on your AbstractGateway), talk with them, watch their memory as a live graph, and read their diaries. A thin React client served by the `abstractentity` command with no server state of its own; every view is read from the gateway and the memory engine's replay stream.

Key facts:
- Run: `npx @abstractframework/entity` (or `npm install -g @abstractframework/entity`, then `abstractentity`). Serves `http://127.0.0.1:3007`, and at `/apps/entity/` through a gateway that manages it; Node.js 18 or newer; launch flags `--gateway-url` (aliases `--gateway`, `--url`; default: the gateway installed on this computer from `~/.abstractframework/gateway.json`, else `http://127.0.0.1:8080`), `--port`, `--host` (default `127.0.0.1`); `ABSTRACTENTITY_GATEWAY_URL`, `PORT`, `HOST` are legacy aliases below the flags.
- Version 0.12.0 (`@abstractframework/ui-kit` ^0.9.28, `@abstractframework/panel-chat` ^0.9.12 from npm): the five-state phase bar, Settings → Mind with its Sleep card, `@` mentions, reply badges, his topics and his brief on the Card tab need AbstractGateway 0.21.0 or newer; an older gateway gets one sentence per surface ("This gateway does not serve the phase bar yet.", "This gateway does not offer mentions yet", "This gateway does not serve topics yet.", "This gateway does not serve his brief yet.") and the rest of the app works.
- First entity: with no entity the app shows "No entities yet" and a **Create your first entity** button; `/#new` (or `/#/new`) opens the creation form directly. Type a **Name** and press **Create entity**; **Advanced: starting document** takes your own YAML. The gateway console's **Create your first entity** button needs AbstractGateway 0.4.1 or newer; the app works with any gateway.
- URLs: `/?entity=NAME` (live), `&live=0` (replay from the start), `/?src=URL` (exported stream); with no reachable gateway the app opens a bundled demo life.
- Layout (README "What you can do in the app"): the home page shows one entity card per row on a phone, two up to 1199 px, three from 1200 px, four from 1700 px; the entity page's side tabs read Chat, Card, Health, Book, World (his world model: how he represents and sees the world), Lessons, Detail, Ledger (Chat and Card once signed in).
- Sign-in: the shared app-origin proxy (`POST /api/connection/gateway`, HttpOnly cookies, `/api/gateway/*` proxied); tokens never stored in the browser. With `@abstractframework/app-server` 0.1.10 or newer the proxy sends the browser's connection address as `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-AbstractFramework-App-Proxy: abstractentity` to the gateway.
- Responsive layout (README "Responsive layout"): below 1024 px the side panel is a drawer over the graph (Escape, outside tap or close button); below 768 px or on a phone held sideways the tabs are a bottom strip and dialogs open as bottom sheets; with the on-screen keyboard open an open panel fills the screen above it; graph overlays go compact below 860 px of graph width (toolbar and legend scroll sideways, layout buttons glyph-only, the Topics panel stops floating and opens as a sheet); on a phone the open Cognitive Monitor takes the place of the timeline's lanes; below 768 px the transcript, ledger, health panel and entity list are flat full-width sections; below 1024 px the Detail tab's lists fold (remembered per browser); touch targets are at least 44 px, text fields 16 px, no text under 14 px on touch screens (transcript 15 px); desktop text at least 13 px (ledger and tool grants 12 px).
- Voice in a visit (docs/api.md "Voice uses the same gateway routes"): a reply's speaker (or Read aloud) posts to `POST /entities/{name}/voice/tts/stream` with no voice field, so the entity's own voice (else the gateway `output.voice` default) speaks, streamed sentence by sentence, Stop aborts; the composer microphone uploads the recording to session `entity_voice_<name>` and transcribes with `POST /runs/{run}/audio/transcribe` (gateway default STT unless overridden), showing `Transcribing… N s · <route>`, failing as a sentence after 180 s; Settings → voice = the ui-kit `AfVoiceSection` (devices, mic test, language, Read aloud; defaults from `GET /voice/defaults`; no text-to-speech override). Needs AbstractGateway 0.13.0 or later.
- Digital identity (docs/api.md "Identity and track record"; framework ADR 0052; AbstractGateway 0.20.0): Settings → identity = the ui-kit `IdentityPanel` (look, voice with a sample on the entity's own lane, Create a new voice, history, one Save at the bottom): the entity's avatar design (AbstractAvatar catalog, Watch-drawable designs only) + colour + voice, one Save (`PUT /entities/{name}/identity`, the whole record); a refusal's sentence shown verbatim, never retried, with a Download button from `error.download`; a record without a voice shows the gateway's `note` sentence, never a voice; History = every `?rev=N`, newest first. Settings → track record = sessions/runs/successes/failures/tokens, trust per task kind with its support ("No experience yet" at 0), whom it met (people, entities). The Avatar view draws the visit's `identity_ref` (open answer or newest public update) in its design and colour; none = the kit's avatar.
- Cognitive Monitor (README "What you can do in the app"): opened with **🧠 Monitor** after **Live** in the timeline's controls, shown inside the timeline in the free space right of the lanes, never taller than them (a small bloom, its closest register on hover, and the tone row; opening it moves neither the graph, the timeline nor the side panel; on a phone it takes the lanes' place; not shown beside the Avatar view); it reads nothing while closed; opening it is what reads his words, once per entity, kept while the page is open (another entity's page opens with it closed), after checking the home's embedding model and the embedding route (without them it reads nothing, his book is never opened, and says "no embeddings · set up" or "could not read", the reason on hover; a failed read is retried on the next opening); replaying, it shows his words at the timeline's position; live with the chat open, the reply in view with its conduct gauge; its ⓘ card (hover, focus, long press) gives the framing (his words, not his inner state), the five tone channels (warmth, tension, reflection, structure, certainty) on one −1..+1 scale, and the basis. Without embeddings (503 on `POST /embeddings`, or no embedder for the home): "no embeddings · set up", the sentence "Embeddings are not configured on this gateway, so the cognitive monitor cannot run." on hover, **set up** links to the console's Multimodal page (`/console#defaults`); every other refusal shows its `detail` sentence (`refusalDetail` in `src/stream_source.ts`), never the JSON body.
- State at any scrub position is a pure fold of the replay stream; replay, live tail and scrub are one code path. Diary redaction is never reconstructed; tool use renders from data, never prose; the Cognitive Monitor reads the expressive character of the entity's words, not inner state.
- Life cycle (docs/entity-phases.md): five states, idle (awake, nothing to do; a new entity starts here), personal (own time, granted or taken back only by the guardian with the `personal` toggle), work (jobs queued for it; no work switch), visit (opens in every state except stopped, waits for the current step without failing, returns to the previous state), sleep (maintenance: consolidates and enriches memory; returns to the previous state); an idle entity sleeps once `sleep.after_hours` (default 24, 1-720) or `sleep.after_events` new memories (default 500) since its last sleep are reached, or more than `sleep.after_fragmented_share` of its memories are not yet settled (default 0.15, 0 < x ≤ 1, shown as 15 %) (Settings → Mind → Sleep, `GET/PUT /entities/{name}/cognition-profile`). Stop halts everything and revokes own time; Resume lands idle. Every interaction forms a memory. Routes (docs/api.md "Life cycle"): `GET /entities/{name}/life_state`, `PUT …/life_state/toggles {personal}`, `POST …/lifecycle {action: stop|resume|retry}`, `POST …/state {state: sleep, dream: true}`; live `phase_changed` host events on the replay stream, highest `rev` wins. Older gateways: "This gateway does not serve the phase bar yet." Known limits: a Stop may let one in-flight model call finish; a mention's visit closes after 5 minutes without a new mention.
- `@` mentions (docs/api.md "Mentions in a conversation"): in a visit or flow-brain conversation, `@` offers the entities `GET /entities` returns (not the one visited); each picked chip is one `POST /sessions/{session_id}/mentions {entity, text, mention_index, repeat_of?, mention_id}`, sent in pick order after the previous answered (the second reads the first); answers labelled from `author` (avatar, name, "entity" tag); 409 "<name> is in another conversation." then the next; 503 puts words and unanswered chips back; a resend with the same `mention_id` returns the first answer; a gateway without the route: "This gateway does not offer mentions yet".
- His topics (docs/api.md "His topics"): `GET /entities/{name}/communities` payload version 2 (memory forms, titles and lays out his topics in his sleep); with topics served they ARE the graph's layout (circles at `layout.xy`/`radius`, members on their seats, no force simulation), the **topics** toggle shows circles, titles and the Topics panel (biggest first; a topic unfolds to its facts and members; "N memories · M loaded in this view" when they differ; "Its memories are outside the loaded window."); titles and summaries are memory's own ("title being written…" while pending); `communities_changed` host marker re-reads once, `placed` events seat a new memory with "placed until his next sleep"; before his first sleep "His topics form during his next sleep."; older gateway "This gateway does not serve topics yet." (plain force layout, never computed in the app). Topics panel (README "Reading the memory graph"): opens docked top right on a wide graph; dragged by its head (or grip) anywhere on the page, its head kept inside the window; its bottom-right corner resizes it, only the edge under the pointer moving (a moved panel grows toward the bottom right, a docked one grows downward only and stays docked; 240-560 px wide; a move keeps the height); **put back** docks it; remembered per browser; one card per topic tinted with its circle's colour, a click (Enter, Space) on an unfolded card folds it back, and focusing another topic folds the previous one (one unfolded at a time); a topic's **Memory types** fold (closed by default; rest on a type lights its memories, click lists them) and its paths most travelled (up to five pairs; rest lights the two memories, click frames them). Graph toolbar: search, topics, Context, and a focused topic's one-line chip (click it, or unpress **topics**, to let the topic go); the two-line legend under the graph is clickable (a kind or link type lights and frames where it sits; Escape lets go); closed memories (replaced or retracted) are hidden until the "◌ N closed memories" toggle just before **fit**; layout buttons freeze and settle (plain layout only) and fit. Graph colours (README "Reading the memory graph"): memory fill runs dark grey (rarely used) to green (most used), ranked within each life; lines stay one quiet dark grey except his walked trails, faint green up to bright and wider for his most used; hovering or selecting a memory lights its own lines and dims the rest; amber = a pair just travelled; after a reply, Context rings: gold = present by right, pink = continuity (followed from the last ones), blue = matched to this message, and each lit path is in its ring's colour; memory's named relations are always the quiet dark grey with a mark at their target end; hover waits 150 ms.
- Reply badges (docs/api.md "Replies, badges and cut summaries"): what a turn formed is served beside the reply (`reply_notices` on a visit turn, `notices` on a flow-brain answer), one badge each inside the reply under his words (diary, lesson, interest, question, realization; a private diary entry shows no words), click opens its record; under the badges a left-aligned chip row sums up the turn ("44 memories" → the turn's Context tab, "1 formed" / "1 diary" → that record in Detail, "0 tools" → its Tools tab); while a visit closes, the conversation's last row reads "Closing — reflection runs now" with an italic narration line and the reflection's acts; a record served with `cut: true` shows its title and "Older record: its summary was cut when saved; he rewrites it in his sleep."
- Optional Avatar conversation (README): Chat remains the default; Avatar centers one live line of public updates and a Findings panel without changing work, drafts or file controls. New Avatar visits and Flow turns opt in to public updates. Durable visit guidance/answers use owned visit routes; summoned Flow turns use their principal-owned replay view and commands. Only explicit public updates and screened replies enter captions or narration. Needs AbstractGateway 0.19.0 or newer; the live line's finding/progress types and the Findings panel need 0.20.0. Questions, permission requests and completion each signal with both a visual and an audio cue (no cue settings inside the view); read-aloud uses the entity's existing voice; history/reconnect/hidden panels stay silent.

## Core docs

- [README.md](README.md): what an entity is and its life cycle, your first entity, install and run, the app's surfaces (phase bar, memory graph and topics, Cognitive Monitor, `@` mentions, reply badges), reading the memory graph (colours, legend, Topics panel), responsive layout, known limits.
- [docs/README.md](docs/README.md): documentation index.
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): install, sign in, create your first entity, talk with it.
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): components and gateway routes (Mermaid diagrams), the replay-stream fold, `src/` module map, invariants, serving.
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): command, environment variables, app URLs, server routes, gateway routes the app uses, the life cycle (phase bar, sleep thresholds), his topics, reply badges and cut summaries, `@` mentions (including the flow-brain `summon` `mentions`), voice in a visit.
- [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md): entities, names, starting documents, what an entity does when nobody talks to it, what the Cognitive Monitor measures, the graph's colours, diary privacy, gateway versions, the About dialog (`GET /api/gateway/about`), phones and tablets.
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): demo instead of entities, sign-in, missing console button, creation refusals, gaps, the phase bar not served, own time stopped unexpectedly (Retry), mentions not offered, no topics on the graph, the Cognitive Monitor refusing to score or without embeddings, About showing the gateway unavailable, ports, copy over plain http (tailscale serve), build.

## Topic deep dives

- [docs/Overview.md](docs/Overview.md): goals, the challenge, core components, honesty invariants.

- [docs/entity-phases.md](docs/entity-phases.md): the entity life cycle: five states (idle, own time, work, visit, sleep), sleep thresholds, Stop and Resume, reading the phase bar (phone layout included), known limits; companion to `spec/entity_phases.json` (version 25).
